The '''Secure-A3 Comlink''' was a common, handheld communications device.

==Characteristics==
[[File:Secure-A3_Comlink_holder.jpg|thumb|left|100px|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka's]] [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] holder.]]
Produced by [[Naboo Technologies/Legends|Naboo Technologies]], the Secure-A3 comlink was an incredibly lightweight [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]. It was top-of-the-line and designed primarily for military use. Though this particular model was available only on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], similar models were available on most technologically advanced worlds across the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. This comlink could send encrypted messages which were incredibly difficult to decipher if they were intercepted by unintended recipients. This comlink came with a holder that could securely grasp the unit to a belt or pocket.
